_comment: Dynamic templates for booking_history.description. Placeholders are [UPPERCASE] tokens; integrations/repo/history_repo.py:render_description(key, **params) substitutes them (a param `old_status` fills the [OLD_STATUS] token). Keep tokens in sync with the callers.
manager_avans_change: Изменен сумма полученного аванса с [OLD_AMOUNT] на [NEW_AMOUNT]
manager_kaspi_qr_change: Изменен сумма оплаты через KaspiQR c [OLD_AMOUNT] на [NEW_AMOUNT]
manager_cash_change: Изменен сумма оплаты наличными с [OLD_AMOUNT] на [NEW_AMOUNT]
cancel_all_bookings: Все последующие брони начиная с [DATE] отменены для клиента [CUSTOMER_NAME] [CUSTOMER_PHONE]
